next_action.rationale: Test dock capacity hypothesis directly. Determine: (1) Is east-node dock at or near capacity? (2) Are there pending pickups or backlog? (3) Is capacity available for new orders? If dock is capacity-constrained, it would explain why carriers aren't collecting (no space). If dock has capacity, it points to carrier-side booking/feed issue with split-reservations. This discriminates between dock_capacity and allocation_rule_defect/carrier_feed_lag hypotheses.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Determines if physical east-node dock capacity is the bottleneck or if the issue is upstream in carrier booking/feed processing
